purpose: Inspect a single recorded charging session, its invoice/pack energy reconciliation, physics, energy ledger, charging curves, vehicle parameters and share links.
primaryGoal: Understand what happened during this session, distinguish measured versus billed or inferred information, inspect specialist evidence, and optionally print or share it.

Session-owned readings; safeArray normalization; AbortSignal forwarded; independent historical DataState. Canonical typed energy fields coexist with optional display aliases; actual alias population and units were not verified.
Uses the session vehicle rather than the workspace vehicle; title/identity enrichment only; no explicit local failure/retry presentation.

Historical query policy, readPhysicsLedger adapter, truncation warning; adapter internals not inspected.

Page uses SI distance, energy and power converters at render boundaries; configured cost fallback and specialist invoice formatting retained. Preference hook internals not inspected.

duplicatedPatterns.detail: Local isDC and synthesizeCurve compete with charging-curve/helpers.ts isDcSession/generateChargingCurve and chargeBillTruth.ts isDcCharger. They have materially different AC classification and model defaults.
duplicatedPatterns.fix: Resolve classification against the actual source contract in the existing charging domain owner; retain distinct model explanations until equivalence is proven. Do not silently substitute one curve for another.

duplicatedPatterns.detail: Three time-chart frames repeat source-state branching, export/table metadata, synchronization and cursor wiring; they already share EmbeddedChart and ChargingChartSync.
duplicatedPatterns.fix: Keep existing shared chart owners. If local extraction is useful, retain all chart-specific columns, axes, series and persistent chart keys; no new global chart engine.

observed: CardGrid has full/half sizing and named source placements.
Gauges use container-responsive 2/3/5-column reflow; progress and summary use container breakpoints.
Chart sections use min-w-0 and explicit mobileHeight; timestamp content reflows.
Header actions/status metadata wrap; back link has an explicit 44px target.

issues.detail: Share cards use a single flex row with two trailing actions and a nonwrapping metadata row. Long expiry labels, RTL and 320px may crowd the controls; title truncation hides full text.
issues.fix: Exercise narrow/long-label states; allow metadata wrapping or stacked actions and retain discoverable full titles without dropping share details.

responsive.requiredValidation: 320/375/390/430/768/1024/1280/1440/1920/2560px, allocated container widths, 200% text, RTL, long labels and open share dialog.

accessibility.status: source-inspected; keyboard, screen reader, contrast, forced colors and reduced motion unverified
observed: Localized back-link accessible name and visible focus classes.
Status text accompanies semantic badges; most page icons explicitly decorative.
Charts carry localized labels, data columns and full-resolution exports.
At more than 2000 telemetry rows the accessible table is deliberately omitted, with a spoken summary and every visual sample retained.
Existing Modal and shared controls own dialog interactions; runtime focus not tested.

issues.detail: The curve X-axis uses hardcoded 'SoC %', unlike its localized series/table headings. The no-table dense-series path offers only a general description, not equivalent navigable sample data within the chart.
issues.fix: Localize the axis using the existing catalog. Preserve the documented dense-series cap and exports; validate accessible export/table alternatives before proposing any changed dense-series renderer.

issues.detail: Revoke is a small icon-only button; a localized name is present, but effective touch size/focus and pending duplicate-click behavior require verification.
issues.fix: Use the existing Button target-size behavior and mutation pending state; verify 44px reachability and keyboard feedback without altering revoke semantics.

states.primary: Session initial loading keeps header and 15 named source shells. Missing session shows QueryError with retry/list navigation plus source outlines. Retained session survives refresh failure with warning/provenance.
states.telemetry: Timeline, temperature and electrical sections separately render loading, fatal error with retry, chart or explanatory empty state. Retained telemetry warning is present.
states.live: Advanced parameters independently render loading/error/usable retained values/unavailable; explicitly labeled latest reported values. Current vehicle state also appears in the historical session status row.
states.sharing: Loading/error/empty/list states preserved; create and revoke errors use mutation toasts. Existing-share error has no local retry.
states.specialists: Physics and ledger have loading and fatal retry states, but return null inside their shells for resolved absent payload and do not show refresh warnings.

issues.detail: Absent telemetry, including initial load or failure, yields a plausible 21-point curve using default 0/100% and 50kW values. A small 'estimated' label exists, but the curve and export use the same chart affordances as measured data.
issues.fix: Do not introduce or amplify fabricated evidence. Preserve the existing modeled capability distinctly as a labeled model with input provenance, while showing telemetry loading/error/unavailable and retry separately; never promote model points into recorded data.

issues.detail: Missing energy, end SoC, peak/average power become numeric zero in summary/gauges; progress computes unknown SoC endpoints as zero. durationMinutes returns zero for ongoing/invalid intervals. Unknown readings can be described as source measurements available.
issues.fix: Preserve every metric but pass nullable raw values and explicit missing reasons to existing metric owners; keep genuine zero and billed-versus-pack precedence distinct. Treat unknown/ongoing duration separately from measured zero.

issues.detail: Physics and ChargeLedgerCompactPanel retain successful data via useDataState but have no retained-refresh warning; resolved missing payload renders no useful body.
issues.fix: Reuse StaleRefreshWarning and EmptyState in each independent specialist shell; preserve honesty text, truncation warning, story, schedule and navigation.

issues.detail: physics.story.map and nested etiquette/schedule access assume complete payloads. ChargePhysics types declare them required; actual backend nullability was not inspected, so this is a contract-hardening risk, not a reproduced crash.
issues.fix: Verify real response shape and normalize nullable collections at the existing typed boundary; guard missing nested evidence without manufacturing values.

visualIssues.detail: Five gauge accents and charts hardcode saturated hex colors, including cyan #00f0ff. Source scan found 18 hex literals, despite existing chartTokens cursor/axis owners. Gauge glow fields are defined but not passed; this is not evidence of rendered glow.
visualIssues.fix: Reuse existing restrained theme/chart palette and semantic tokens for gauge and series colors. Reduce decorative gradient intensity without removing series, user palette choices, curve meaning or legends.

visualIssues.detail: Dialog uses raw p/h3 typography classes and fixed green-400/red-400 rather than existing Text/role wrappers and semantic tokens.
visualIssues.fix: Use existing Text/PanelTitle/Caption and semantic status/danger tokens, retaining all text, input labels and actions; no new typography abstraction.

visualIssues.detail: Compact ledger wraps ChargeLedgerPanel, which supplies another GlassPanel/title, producing nested panel chrome for one ledger source.
visualIssues.fix: Assess mounted hierarchy; preserve full ledger content and both navigation/truncation metadata. Only request an embedded variant of the existing ledger renderer if supported by concrete additional consumers.

architectureIssues.detail: Energy chart uses optional energy_added directly and labels it kWh. The inspected type instead exposes canonical ac_charging_energy_in_wh/dc_charging_energy_in_wh. Live battery_range_mi is passed to a meters converter; actual wire semantics of that legacy-named field were not established.
architectureIssues.fix: Trace the current backend payload before changing calculations. Bind to verified SI source fields and convert only for display/export; do not infer units from legacy aliases or add a dual-shape adapter.

architectureIssues.detail: Historical session UI also displays current vehicle charging state in the summary without a local 'current vehicle' qualifier. Detail route range control is disabled by exact-path membership; workspace vehicle selector remains enabled, although this page correctly queries the record's vehicle.
architectureIssues.fix: Retain record-owned scope and advanced live capability; label current-vehicle status distinctly from session ended_status and expose freshness. Have workspace owner assess record-detail vehicle-selector semantics rather than adding another picker or range.

architectureIssues.detail: Feature dependencies import concrete layout-reference/stat-reference sub-barrels even though canonical category barrels are available.
architectureIssues.fix: Use existing layout/data-display category exports without changing public component ownership or creating wrappers.

architectureIssues.detail: toDistanceDisplay is recreated each render and included in timeSeriesData useMemo dependencies; this invalidates mapping memoization even for very large retained telemetry.
architectureIssues.fix: Use existing converter directly with primitive preference dependency or stable useCallback; preserve every sample and avoid unmeasured downsampling.

order: Verify SI aliases and source trust; remove unknown-as-zero implications.

competingImplementations.detail: isDC treats any nonempty non-unknown type, including 'ac', as DC; chargeBillTruth.isDcCharger explicitly excludes 'ac'; curve/helpers.isDcSession uses charging category and peak-power evidence.
competingImplementations.fix: Unify verified classification in the existing domain owner, retaining intended behavior for every charger category; resolve before changing curve inference.
